title: Automatically display stock when available
desc: Show the stock model in the 3D viewer when stock dimensions are parsed from the G-code header. You can still toggle stock from the viewer toolbar.

title: Enable Syntax Highlighting
desc: Colorize G-code tokens in the file viewer. Disable on low-end machines for better scroll performance.

title: Comments
desc: Color for parenthetical (...) and semicolon comments.

title: G Commands
desc: Color for G commands (G0, G1, G28, etc.).

title: M Commands
desc: Color for M commands (M3, M5, M6, etc.).

title: Feed Rate (F)
desc: Color for the feed rate parameter.

title: Spindle Speed (S)
desc: Color for the spindle speed parameter.

title: Line Number (N)
desc: Color for line number codes (N100, etc.).

title: Other Parameters
desc: Color for other parameters (I, J, K, P, R, etc.).

title: O-code Label
desc: Color for O-block labels (O100, O200, etc.).

title: O-code Keyword
desc: Color for O-code flow keywords (if, while, repeat, sub, call, etc.).

title: Parameter Variables (#)
desc: Color for numbered parameter references (#101, #5023, etc.).

title: Math Keywords
desc: Color for bracket-math keywords (eq, gt, sin, sqrt, mod, and, etc.).

title: Shell Commands
desc: Color for Shell command names in the MDI history and IntelliSense popups (ls, cat, $J, etc.).
